instruction: Compare MacBook Pro 14-inch with MacBook Pro 16-inch and MacBook Air

metadata.explanation: Variation comparing MacBook models using the same Apple comparison interface. The agent needs to navigate to the MacBook comparison page and select the three specified models: MacBook Pro 14-inch, MacBook Pro 16-inch, and MacBook Air. Uses existing evaluator that parses the modelList parameter from the active tab URL.
metadata.verification: The expected modelList values match Apple's URL parameter format for MacBook models. Similar to the original iPhone comparison task, maintaining similar complexity and interaction pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts modelList parameter from active tab URL using get_active_tab_url_parse getter
Metric check_direct_json_object properly compares the extracted model list with expected values
Expected values are semantically correct - model identifiers match Apple's URL format (macbook-pro-14, macbook-pro-16, macbook-air)
Split_list configuration correctly handles comma-separated URL parameter values
Ignore_list_order configuration is appropriate since comparison order is not specified in instruction
Complete coverage - all three MacBook models mentioned in instruction are verified
Logic flow is sound: active tab URL → parse query params → extract modelList → split → compare
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding URL domain validation to ensure user is on apple.com comparison page (though goto_prefix partially addresses this)
